Combat uses shaped health and attack grids. Individual [[Bestiary|creature]], [[NPCs|character]], and [[Items|item]] pages own their base patterns and cell values.

The original diagrams on this wiki use text and colored cells, not game images. Red cells show unarmored health or an attack range; brown health cells also display their armor count. Empty positions are left blank.
